name: Aura of Sanctity
description: Reduces darkness by 50. At the start of battle, grants all allies Radiant Blessing (+40% status immunity, +25% damage against Undead, +10 flat damage reduction, +3% HP regeneration per turn). Each turn, cleanses 1 negative effect from the most debuffed ally. Basic attacks heal the ally with the lowest HP for 40% of the damage dealt. Intercepts 30% of enemy AoE damage for same-row allies.
